meta.title: Clear Cart — Photograph the product, know what's inside
meta.description: Clear Cart recognises the product in your hand and checks its ingredients against your own allergy profile. No more squinting at the fine print.
meta.ogImageAlt: Clear Cart — product scanning app for people with food allergies

hero.title: Photograph the product. Know what's inside in seconds.
hero.subtitle: Clear Cart recognises the product in your hand and checks its ingredients against your own allergy profile. No more squinting at the fine print.
hero.imageAlt: Phone showing the Clear Cart app opening screen.

problem.heading: Shopping with an allergy is exhausting.

cards.title: Fine print.
cards.body: On most products the ingredient list is too small to read.

cards.title: Recipes change.
cards.body: A product you trust can be reformulated without notice.

cards.title: Not only for you.
cards.body: You run the same check for your child, your guest, your friend.

how.heading: Three steps to an answer.
how.note: Product recognition is powered by AI-assisted visual matching.

steps.title: Take a photo.
steps.body: Snap the product — even faster if the barcode is visible.

steps.title: We identify it.
steps.body: Clear Cart finds the product by its barcode or by how it looks.

steps.title: See the warning.
steps.body: Ingredients are matched against your allergy profile and anything risky is flagged.

items.title: Your own profile.
items.body: Pick your allergens once; every check uses them.

items.title: Barcode and visual matching.
items.body: If the barcode won't scan, the photo still works.

items.title: Seconds, not minutes.
items.body: No standing in the aisle reading labels.
